We need to return all possible precursors of applying the template (from make_5_lvl2-template_search-2) to the molecule given in make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1 answer. That answer gave three SMILES strings (maybe three stereoisomers) as the target molecule? Actually those are likely product molecules (the molecule to apply template to). The template_id is 1914389. We need to apply that template to each of those SMILES to get precursors. Use apply_template tool with each SMILES and template_id.

We have three SMILES strings in list of lists? The answer from make_5_lvl2-apply_template-1 is a list of lists each containing one SMILES? Actually answer: '[["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO"], ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C)[C@H]1C)CO"], ["C/C(=C/[C@H]1O[C@@H](C/C=C/C=C/C(=O)O)C[C@H](O)[C@H]1C)CO[Si](C)(C)C(C)(C)C"]]' So three entries each a list with one SMILES. So we have three target molecules.

We need to apply template 1914389 to each. Use apply_template tool. Let's do that.
